claims.assertion: Athena rejects an Antarctic postwar surrender story, describing puppet leaders instead pledging loyalty to Cabal and nonhuman controllers linked to the Federation.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: Her account; she says Federation authorities permit events under nonintervention.

claims.assertion: Anéeka describes Antarctica as a military-controlled zone with ancient ruins and bases used by several Federation species; she says giant awakening claims are unconfirmed.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She explicitly says the giant claim is not confirmed.
